phases.goal: Grip the mouse without treating the cyan mat as active.
phases.name: grip_mouse
phases.verify: Mouse moves with or remains in contact with the gripper.

phases.goal: Move and release the mouse onto the Cyan mat.
phases.name: place_mouse_on_mat
phases.verify: Mouse is supported on the mat and gripper is clear.

semantic_recipe.relation_to_jsonl: Phases are transferable task guidance; the companion JSONL is the exact historical winning command sequence.

strategy_notes.coordinate_policy: Relocalize all objects, supports, contacts, and poses from current observations; do not reuse s0 coordinates.
critical_gates: Mouse is the moved object, not the mat.
Mouse visibly leaves the table or moves with gripper before transport.
Release only when mouse is over a supportable mat region.

task_language: Grip the the mouse with scroll wheel in center and move it onto the Cyan mat.
vla_recipe: Exact sequence: 1:lingbot_act(chunks=2,use_length=50); 2:lingbot_act(chunks=1,use_length=50). For every lingbot_act, use the original task_language exactly; relocalize every pose from current observations; do not replay clean coordinates.

notes: Avoid releasing after unverified mouse contact; verify the mouse moves with the gripper and is supported on the Cyan mat before retreat.
